alerte.texte: Your fast-tab bug is fixed and merged, and so is the Expo update, with Nearby redrawing less. Tonight the Claudes here found and fixed real causes in six PRs: vote, composer, native tabs, haptic tick, profile and row haptics. The full test loop runs on the Mac on main with the new Expo.

depuis.texte: Expo update, with Nearby redrawing less. Replaces Jordan's PR, which is now closed.
Server: an expert note's lock folds into its upsert (Jordan).
Server: a tip's admission decision and insert happen in one go (Jordan).
Your fast-tab bug: on the profile, the page follows the chosen tab again, even with chained taps and swipes.
Server: prototype of exact publication counting (Jordan).
Server: a report reads its outcome and the reporter's lock in one go (Jordan).
Notifications: rows no longer move under your finger, and the list is ready before you arrive.
Tools: the app's ESLint replaced by oxlint (Jordan).
Tools: Prettier replaced by oxfmt (Jordan).
Server: recursive SQL counts stay fresh through the cache (Jordan).
Server: the route census opens the seeded announcement (Jordan).
Explore keeps its read failures and retries them. Replaces the old PR #4507.
App: required route parameters are kept (Jordan).
Wheel titles without “(HH:mm)”, in all six languages.
Privacy: real values, greyed out while loading.
A website script fixed: CI did not cover it.
Video preview: pause holds when you change the speed.
Main's CI is green again: Expo Doctor no longer blocks.
Intermediate sweep evidence recorded (Jordan).
Announcement opening measured only with available test data (Jordan).
The vote streak is removed everywhere, as you decided.

claude.libelle: A Claude is fixing it here

enCours.ouEnEst: Design approved by you. Reviewed, CI green. The batch measurement shows the Messages screen redrawing more often during the tab tour (21 times instead of 15). Mentions work, with less jank than main.
enCours.reste: A Claude here is finding which PR causes the extra redraws, then fixes it there. Then merge.

enCours.sujet: Tabs: instant arrival and a stable return to Messages
enCours.ouEnEst: Reviewed, CI green. Faster than main on the tab tour, but it may be the cause of the extra Messages redraws.
enCours.reste: Same investigation as Messages. Then merge, before or after Profile.

enCours.sujet: Composer: the refresh waits until it is closed
enCours.ouEnEst: The batch measurement showed the work had only moved to the Profile visit. Fixed: everything is re-read once, during a quiet moment. Then a duplicate request on slow servers, also fixed.
enCours.reste: Review of the last fix, and a measurement running. Then merge.

enCours.sujet: Vote: chart and results in sync as soon as you vote
enCours.ouEnEst: Reviewed, CI green, five-pass measurement good when voting. You decided the refused-vote case: it stays shown like an Instagram like, with the counter up and no message.
enCours.reste: The Claude applies your rule, then a quick review. Then merge.

enCours.sujet: Profile: opens instantly, without the header jumping
enCours.ouEnEst: The extra long frames came from preparing every tab at once. Fixed: the other tabs open after the first one has drawn. New measurement within main's spread.
enCours.reste: A Claude here merges main and renumbers its database migration. Then review, CI and merge.

enCours.sujet: Map: no longer drifts by itself after a search
enCours.ouEnEst: Reviewed, CI green. Measured on fair paths, it goes 1 to 2 dropped frames past main's spread during the flight.
enCours.reste: A Claude here finds where that comes from and renumbers its database migrations. Then merge.

enCours.sujet: Native tabs: labels and selection in sync
enCours.ouEnEst: Changes native code. Dark mode and Increase Contrast fixed and checked on the real app: the right tab lights up. Reviewed at zero, CI green.
enCours.reste: A cleaner measurement is running for a small gap when entering Activity. Then merge.

enCours.sujet: Haptics on tab rows, when passing and on arrival
enCours.ouEnEst: Measurement within main's spread. Main merged in, with five conflicts resolved, and per-gesture tests added.
enCours.reste: Review of the merge, then CI and merge.

enCours.ouEnEst: Changes native code. The launch slowdown is fixed: the haptics now prepare after launch. The tick now arrives on time from the very first tap.
enCours.reste: Last case: the very first swipe right after launch. A Claude here is closing it. Then review, CI and measurement.

equipe: Here on the Mac: Claudes fixing Vote, Profile, Map, the haptic tick, the Messages redraws and a flaky test, plus the full test loop on main with the new Expo.
On Replicas: the measurers, each with its own virtual iPhone from the included pool, and the reviewers.
etapes: Merge each PR as soon as its measurement comes back clean, in the right order: Tabs before Profile.
Fix here what the measurements found: the extra Messages redraws, the map flight, the haptic tick's first swipe, and the flaky Explore test.
Full test loop on the final main. A loop on tonight's main already passed green: 21 flows, no regression.
Redeploy the staging API on that same commit: build 196's notifications need it.
Bench tour, then the list of what won't be in the build, with reasons, shown to you.
Launch build 196, then hand you the emulator on Ava, on main.
